label: select
example: SELECT id, name FROM dbunny_snippet_t WHERE id = 1

label: update
example: UPDATE dbunny_snippet_t SET name = 'b' WHERE id = 1

label: with
example: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM dbunny_snippet_t) SELECT id FROM x

label: case
example: SELECT CASE WHEN id > 0 THEN 'a' ELSE 'b' END FROM dbunny_snippet_t

label: join
example: SELECT * FROM dbunny_snippet_t a JOIN dbunny_snippet_t b ON a.id = b.id

label: upsert
template:
INSERT INTO ${table} (${key}, ${column}) VALUES (${values})
ON CONFLICT (${key}) DO UPDATE SET ${column} = EXCLUDED.${column}
example: INSERT INTO dbunny_snippet_t (id, name) VALUES (1, 'a') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name

label: create table
example: CREATE TABLE dbunny_snippet_new (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, name text)

label: merge
example: MERGE INTO dbunny_snippet_t t USING (SELECT 1 AS id, 'a' AS name) s ON t.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET name = s.name WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, name) VALUES (s.id, s.name)
